## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the focused change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Relevant package/desktop checks, or not applicable with rationale
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader impact reviewed
- [ ] Security, privacy, update, and compatibility boundaries reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, prompts/responses, account data, private content, or complete local paths included

## Evidence

List automated results and bounded manual Linux desktop/session evidence. Release claims must identify the exact artifact digest.
